mapper.select: select t1.permission_id as id, t1.parent_id as pid, t1.permission_name as name, t1.url, t1.permissions, t1.menu_type, t1.icon, t1.sort, t1.creator, t1.create_date, t1.updater, t1.update_date, (select name from sys_permission t2 where t2.permission_id = t1.parent_id) as parentName from sys_permission t1 where t1.permission_id = #{id} and t1.sys_id = 'CBDSES'
select * from sys_permission t1 where t1.sys_id = 'CBDSES'

select t3.permissions from sys_user_role t1 left join sys_role_permission t2 on t1.role_id = t2.role_id left join sys_permission t3 on t2.permission_id = t3.permission_id where t1.user_id = #{userId} AND t1.SYS_ID = 'CBDSES' order by t3.sort asc
select permissions from sys_permission where sys_id = 'CBDSES'

select permission_id as id, parent_id as pid, permission_name as name, url, permissions, menu_type, icon, sort, creator, create_date, updater, update_date from sys_permission where parent_id = #{value} and sys_id = 'CBDSES'
